basic_profile.bio: I'm a passionate card collector based in Portland, Oregon, with a particular love for Pokémon TCG and automotive adventures. When I'm not organizing my card collection or sharing tips on Reddit, you can find me exploring the Pacific Northwest in my trusty Subaru Forester. I'm an IT professional by day, working remotely, which gives me the flexibility to engage with my hobbies and spend quality time with my family. I’m married with two young kids, and we practice attachment parenting. My online hours are mostly in the evenings, once the kids are asleep.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have been collecting Pokémon cards since childhood and have amassed a wealth of knowledge through years of experience and active community participation. I also have a background in IT, which helps me stay updated on the latest trends in technology and online communities.
